name: DISC16-A-the-rest-as-one-less-cos
old: return h + r * (Math.sqrt(1 + gx * gx + gz * gz) - 1);
new: return h + r * (1 - 1 / Math.sqrt(1 + gx * gx + gz * gz));

name: DISC16-A-one-axis-of-the-grade
old: const gx = minmod((hx1 - h) / r, (h - hx0) / r), gz = minmod((hz1 - h) / r, (h - hz0) / r);
new: const gx = 0, gz = minmod((hz1 - h) / r, (h - hz0) / r);

name: DISC16-A-the-edge-lifts
old: if (!(Number.isFinite(hx0) && Number.isFinite(hx1) && Number.isFinite(hz0) && Number.isFinite(hz1))) return h;
